fields.name: case_id
fields.operational_purpose: Link request, routing, review and outcome records without requiring a direct personal identifier.
fields.retention_expectation: Synthetic development records may be regenerated or deleted at any time. A concrete pilot retention period must be approved before private data is imported.

fields.name: message
fields.operational_purpose: Understand the service request and support an auditable operational response.
fields.retention_expectation: For any future pilot, keep raw request text only for the approved operational need and a documented short review window, then delete or de-identify it. No pilot value is set until a pilot policy is approved.

fields.name: issue_category
fields.operational_purpose: Represent the service issue in a structured form for routing and aggregate analysis.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain only for the approved evaluation window; do not use it to reconstruct identity.

fields.name: urgency
fields.operational_purpose: Prioritise service handling using a documented operational heuristic.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain with the decision record for reproducibility during the approved evaluation window.

fields.name: frustration
fields.operational_purpose: Represent communication intensity or emotional need for service handling; it is not a psychological diagnosis.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain only with documented scale definitions and for the approved evaluation window. Do not convert it into a resident personality profile.

fields.name: complexity
fields.operational_purpose: Represent estimated operational case complexity for routing and outcome adjustment.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain with the decision record for reproducibility during the approved evaluation window.

fields.name: previous_related_cases
fields.operational_purpose: Represent recurrence without exposing the content of the full historical interaction record.
fields.retention_expectation: Prefer the minimum derived count rather than full message history. Any pilot linkage window must be defined before use.

fields.name: vulnerability_flag
fields.operational_purpose: Trigger additional human attention when service delivery may require accessibility or safety consideration.
fields.retention_expectation: Do not retain longer than the operational need unless a specific evaluation purpose and safeguards are approved.

fields.name: department
fields.operational_purpose: Record recommended or effective routing destination.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain for the approved audit and evaluation window.

fields.name: priority
fields.retention_expectation: Retain for the approved audit and evaluation window.

fields.name: routing_reasons
fields.operational_purpose: Preserve the explanation trail for routing auditability.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain with the routing audit record while the decision must remain reproducible; review free-text reasons for accidental personal data before analytics export.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.operational_purpose: Attribute a human routing confirmation or override to the reviewing actor.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain only for the approved audit requirement and keep it out of general model-training datasets.

fields.name: response_time_minutes
fields.retention_expectation: Retain for the approved outcome-evaluation window.

fields.name: resolution_time_minutes
fields.retention_expectation: Retain for the approved outcome-evaluation window.

fields.name: reassigned
fields.operational_purpose: Measure whether a case changed primary handler or team.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain for the approved outcome-evaluation window.

fields.name: escalated
fields.operational_purpose: Measure whether a case required escalation.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain for the approved outcome-evaluation window.

fields.name: satisfaction
fields.operational_purpose: Represent voluntary service-outcome feedback when collected.
fields.retention_expectation: Retain only for the approved evaluation window and document how the score was collected.

longitudinal_features.name: previous_related_cases
longitudinal_features.operational_purpose: Detect recurrence or unresolved service history using a minimum derived count.
longitudinal_features.retention_rationale: A derived count is less revealing than retaining full historical message content.
longitudinal_features.pilot_requirement: Define the linkage method, notice, access controls and maximum history window before a pilot.

longitudinal_features.name: resident_message_history
longitudinal_features.operational_purpose: Potential future context for recurring service requests.
longitudinal_features.retention_rationale: Full longitudinal free text creates unnecessary privacy and profiling risk for the current project stage.
longitudinal_features.pilot_requirement: Requires a separately approved purpose, notice/consent analysis, minimisation plan, retention period and security review.

longitudinal_features.name: emotion_trajectory
longitudinal_features.operational_purpose: Potential research feature for changes in communication or service need over time.
longitudinal_features.retention_rationale: Longitudinal emotion-like inference can become unsupported psychological profiling if not tightly constrained.
longitudinal_features.pilot_requirement: Requires validated operational definitions, explicit review, a clear necessity case, notice/consent analysis and a prohibition on personality or mental-health inference.

longitudinal_features.name: resident_profile_embedding
longitudinal_features.retention_rationale: Persistent behavioural embeddings are unnecessary for the current routing and evaluation goals.
longitudinal_features.pilot_requirement: Do not implement without a new governance review and documented need.

prohibited_by_default: Commit real private resident or customer service records to Git.
Use direct identifiers in general analytics or model-training exports.
Train on raw private request text without a separately approved purpose and data-use basis.
Treat staff confirmations or overrides as automatic ground truth.
Infer mental-health conditions, personality traits or protected characteristics from service messages.
Create persistent resident-level behavioural profiles or embeddings without a new governance review.
Enable longitudinal personalisation experiments before notice/consent, minimisation, retention and access-control requirements are approved.
